name: Statistic
summary: A single headline number with a caption and optional trend colour.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-statistic> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `label` captions the figure, `value` is the number, `prefix`/`suffix` frame it, and `trend` tints it positive or negative. A static marker — no interactive state, so no motion (like Badge). Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: prefix
props.desc: Small text before the value (e.g. a currency mark)

props.name: suffix
props.desc: Small text after the value (e.g. %, unit)

props.name: trend
props.desc: Tint the value positive or negative

whenToUse.when: a single KPI on a dashboard or results screen
a small count attached to another element
a value's share of a whole

opinion.note: Caption names the metric in sentence case — 'Active players', not 'ACTIVE PLAYERS'. Use trend only when up/down carries meaning; colour alone should never be the only signal.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Statistic cell; spec derived from the token layer (text-default/secondary/tertiary, text-positive/negative) + antd Statistic conventions (24/32 value). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
